name: Demo Glucose Biscuits
ingredients_text: Wheat flour (maida) 62%, sugar, edible vegetable oil (palm), invert syrup, milk solids, raising agents (INS 500(ii), INS 503(ii)), salt, emulsifier (INS 322 (soy lecithin)), artificial flavour (vanilla). Contains wheat, milk and soy.

name: Demo Instant Noodles (Masala)
ingredients_text: Noodles: Refined wheat flour (maida) 80%, palm oil, salt, thickener (INS 412), acidity regulators (INS 501(i), INS 500(i)). Tastemaker: Spices, salt, sugar, flavour enhancers (INS 627, INS 631), hydrolysed vegetable protein, colour (INS 150d). Contains wheat.

name: Demo Cola
ingredients_text: Carbonated water, sugar, acidity regulator (INS 338), colour (INS 150d), caffeine, natural flavours.

name: Demo Salted Potato Chips
ingredients_text: Potato 75%, palmolein oil, salt, antioxidant (INS 319). May contain traces of milk.

name: Demo Whole Wheat Bread
ingredients_text: Whole wheat flour (atta) 80%, water, yeast, sugar, iodised salt, edible vegetable oil, preservative (INS 282), flour treatment agent (INS 300), emulsifier (INS 471). Contains wheat.

name: Demo Rolled Oats
ingredients_text: Rolled oats 100%. May contain traces of wheat.

name: Demo Peanut Butter (Crunchy)
ingredients_text: Roasted peanuts 90%, sugar, iodised salt, edible vegetable oil. Contains peanuts.

name: Demo Mixed Fruit Drink
ingredients_text: Water, sugar, mixed fruit puree 12%, acidity regulator (INS 330), preservative (INS 211), antioxidant (INS 300), colours (INS 110, INS 102), added flavours.
